attributes.readMe:
# Song Version

One mix of the song in one language: the audio, an isolated vocal for timing, a measured tempo map, and the lyrics as lines of timed words you can edit and re-time by ear.

Part of [Lyric Player](../LyricVideo/just-ask-for-it), the Choreo-animated K-pop lyric video by @ctse.
